Dialogs.Dialog: Thanks for having me~!
Anegasaki
It feels like... it's been a while, hasn't it？
Anegasaki
Hasn't it been a really long time？
Anegasaki
It's been a while. Geez, I've been waiting for you.
Anegasaki
Come on, come in. Make yourself at home.
Anegasaki
Welcome in, Mr. Regular.
Anegasaki
Welcome. I won't let you leave today... Just kidding.
Anegasaki
So, what should we do？
What to do, huh... I didn't really have anything in mind.
Honestly, me neither. Just being like this makes me happy...
Yeah... ● do too.
Anegasaki
Oh, did you watch that drama last week？ The Monday one.
I did, I did. The lead girl was really cute...
Hmm？ She was cute, and...？ Go on, finish that sentence.
...Not as cute as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, though.
Anegasaki
Oh, right. I bought a travel magazine.
Are you going on a trip？
Nope, just to browse. It's fun! Want to see？
Let's see here.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. What were you like as a kid？
● don't really remember. Just a normal boy, I guess？ Weren't you pretty wild, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Did I... mention that before？ Yeah, kind of like a neighborhood kid boss.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, a kid boss？ Not a kid boss lady？
What's that, a kid boss lady？ Hehe!
Anegasaki
Hey, what's your dream for the future？
A dream？ That's tough... Hmmmm...
Geez, you're so serious... Don't overthink it so much.
Then I'll make Dixie's the number one family restaurant in Japan!
Really？ Even if our place became number one, only the manager would be happy.
On second thought, never mind...
Anegasaki
...We both went quiet, didn't we？
It happens sometimes. That moment when everything just goes totally silent.
Didn't people use to say a ghost was passing by？
Uh... how did that go again？
Could this be... a generation gap？
(We're only one year apart, though...)
Anegasaki
I really like times like this. It's so relaxing.
Yeah, though my heart's pounding a little too.
Me too. Hehe.
At times like this...
...Makes you wish time would just stop, doesn't it？
(Aw, she beat me to it.)
Anegasaki
Hey, if today were the end of the world, how would you spend what's left？
Well, ●'d want to keep things just like this, I guess.
...Jeez, look at you, being all smooth.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how about you？
...Me too. I'd never let you go home.
(I guess if today's the end, I wouldn't have to go home...)
Anegasaki
Time really does fly when you're having fun, doesn't it？
Yeah, even though class takes forever to end.
Then how about we start class right here？
Ehhhh...
Got a problem with private lessons from Ms. Anegasaki？
(...Put that way, it actually sounds pretty good.)
Anegasaki
Hey, are you keeping up with your studies？
Uh... pretty well, I guess. Why do you ask？
Just got to thinking. Your grades aren't slipping because of me, are they？
I'm fine. You don't need to worry about that at all.
Really？ Well, if you say so...
(I'd better ace the next test to put ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s mind at ease.)
Anegasaki
Huh？ Don't you have dark circles under your eyes？
I don't think that's true, but...
Don't push yourself. Want to take a nap here for a bit？
Haha, I'm fine, really. You sound like my mom.
Hey, 'mom' is going too far! At least say big sister... Wait, no, I hate that too.
Sorry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s my girlfriend, after all.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Do you ever get lonely out of nowhere at night？
In the middle of the night？ I wonder...
I do sometimes. And whenever that happens, I think about you.
About ●？
Yup. And wouldn't you know it, the loneliness fades and I sleep like a baby.
(If ● started thinking about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I don't think I'd get any sleep...)
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, I heard police sirens nearby the other day. Wonder what happened？
Really？ That's scary.
Yeah... But today I'm fine.
Eh？
I'm counting on you, Sir Knight.
Leave it to me.
Anegasaki
Oh, you've got a hair on your shoulder.
Must be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hair.
Hmm... is it really my hair, I wonder？
Of course it is. We're in ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s room, after all.
Hehe, look how flustered you are ▼
Anegasaki
Did you notice？
Huh？ What did I miss...？
I burned a little incense, just a bit...
Oh, now that you mention it, faintly. It's nice like this.
Right？ I'm glad.
Anegasaki
Ah, you just checked the clock, didn't you？
Huh？ I didn't even realize I did.
Really？ Okay then. If you ever want to leave, just say so, okay？
I'd never want to leave. If anything, I never want to go home.
Geez, there you go being adorable again... I really won't let you leave!
Anegasaki
Oh, right! I rented a DVD. Let's watch it together.
Sounds fun! What movie？
They say it's pure terror! Don't worry though, it's just a short film.
Ugh, really...？ Alright, let's do it.
Yay! Let's get cozy and watch it. Hehe.
Anegasaki
Oh, come to think of it... A flyer came for that new supermarket opening up.
Huh, you actually check that stuff？
Of course! ...Ah, sorry. Sounds a bit domestic, doesn't it？
No need to apologize. Domestic is nice, honestly.
Still, I'll wait until you leave to look. It's a little embarrassing.
Anegasaki
Has anything interesting happened lately？
Hmm, nothing particularly exciting, honestly...
No excuses! You can make something up if you want.
Whoa, that's really putting me on the spot!
Then that's your homework for next time. Forget, and I'll make you stand outside!
Seriously...？
Anegasaki
I'm starting to feel kind of sleepy...
Wait, are you bored？
No, not at all! It's just... being with you is so safe, I totally let my guard down.
Oh, well that's good then.
Fufu. Feels like we've been together for decades.
(Decades...？ But ● are only in high school...)
Hey, wanna look at the album？
Anegasaki
The album？ Sure, why not.
Anegasaki
Right now... I'm not really in the mood, honestly.
I see...
Anegasaki
This one brings back some memories.
Anegasaki
From back then... Did we take this？ Brings back memories.
Anegasaki
Ah, this was quite a while ago, wasn't it？
Anegasaki
We were so young back then... ...Just kidding!
Anegasaki
This brings back memories. Do you remember it？
Anegasaki
Oh, that's from the other day, isn't it？
Anegasaki
This one's pretty recent, huh.
Anegasaki
This is... from the other day, right？ When was it again？
Anegasaki
A recent photo, huh. I wonder if this'll be a fond memory someday, too.
Anegasaki
From the other day. I still remember it really well.
Anegasaki
Ah, look, there's this one too.
Anegasaki
Hehe, did we really take this？
Anegasaki
I remember this photo so well.
Anegasaki
You took one like this？ Hehe.
Anegasaki
Oh, when did you sneak this one？
Anegasaki
Looking through our album every now and then is fun, isn't it？
Anegasaki
Great shot. Must be the photographer's skill？
Anegasaki
Oh, I really like this one.
Anegasaki
Yeah, it turned out really well.
Anegasaki
You know, I think I really like this one.
Anegasaki
From our New Year's visit. It was so crowded, wasn't it？
Anegasaki
This is Valentine's Day, right？ Thanks for being so happy with it.
Anegasaki
This is White Day, isn't it？ I'll never forget that.
Anegasaki
This is from Christmas... I hope we can spend it together every year like this.
Anegasaki
...That's my birthday, huh. It's a little embarrassing.
Anegasaki
This one's from your birthday. Hehe, happy birthday once more.
Anegasaki
This photo... It's from a really special day for both of us, isn't it？
Anegasaki
Ah, that day. That was such a wonderful time.
Anegasaki
I'm glad you took this photo. It was such a special day.
Anegasaki
Hey, remember this day？ It was so much fun... I won't ever forget it.
Anegasaki
Let's make lots more memories together from now on, okay？
Anegasaki
Let's look at photos together again sometime, okay？
Anegasaki
Hehe. So many memories came flooding back.
Anegasaki
I love how our memories just keep growing like this.
Anegasaki
Having an album that's just ours makes me so happy.
Anegasaki
It was a little embarrassing... but will you look through it with me again sometime？
Anegasaki
All right, all done. That was fun, wasn't it？
Anegasaki
You really love taking photos. At this rate, we'll have albums piling up everywhere.
Anegasaki
Don't just look at photos— make sure you look at the real me, too, okay？
Anegasaki
Will you keep taking photos of me？ I can't wait.
Hey, want to study for a change？
Anegasaki
Study？ Sure thing. Big sis will teach you.
Anegasaki
Mmm, I'm not really in the mood for that right now...
Oh, okay... We don't have to, then.
Um, hey... Can I take your photo？
Anegasaki
Here？ It's a little embarrassing, but... okay.
Anegasaki
No-ope. Photography is strictly forbidden here.
Aw... That's too bad.
Anegasaki
Hey, wanna look through the album together？
Sounds good.
Not right now.
Anegasaki
Oh... is that so？ Hmph.
Anegasaki
Oh, I know! Why don't we study together？
Let's get right to it.
You're joking, right？
Anegasaki
No good？ Hmm... yeah, you're right.
Anegasaki
Hey, are you still carrying your camera around？
Of course. Let me snap a picture of you.
Yeah, why do you ask？
Anegasaki
I see... No, never mind.
Anegasaki
Oh, let me go... pour us some fresh drinks, okay？
Ah, thanks.
(Alone at my girlfriend's place... My heart's racing.)
Neighbor Lady A
Anegasaki-san, is everything okay？
Anegasaki
Eh？ What do you mean？
I thought I saw a strange man go inside just now.
Oh, it's fine! He's just a friend from school.
Oh goodness, I'm sorry! Things have been unsafe lately, so be careful, okay？
(Did ● really look that suspicious？)
Neighbor Lady B
Oh, Nene-chan. Going out？
Anegasaki
Yes. Just running out to do a little shopping.
What a shame, I was hoping we could have tea together.
Ah, sorry. I have a friend over right now.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s on great terms with the neighbors.)
Canvasser
Excuse me, miss! Which paper do you read？ You only need to try it for a single month!
Anegasaki
Oh, no thank you.
How about some detergent... Or maybe gift certificates？ Or baseball？ I've got tickets!
I said, no thank you!
Er, sorry to bother you...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Impressive as always.)
Detective
Excuse me. Police. Does this photo look familiar？
Anegasaki
...No, I don't.
I see. If you happen to see them, please let us know.
Okay. Um... did something happen？
Oh, no, nothing serious. Well then, excuse me.
(Will it be okay...？)
Neighbor Lady A
Hello, Anegasaki-san. Here's the circular.
Anegasaki
Ah, yes. Thank you.
Hey, listen, can you hear me out for a second？
Oh, um, I'm actually a bit busy right now...
(Looks like she got roped into some small talk...)
Little Girl
Big sis, are you going somewhere？
Anegasaki
Yup, just going shopping.
I'm running an errand for Mommy! Hey, let's go together!
Sure. Shall we walk together, then？
(Just like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. The neighborhood kids really love her.)
Little Boy
Huh？ Big sis, you left the lights on at your place.
Anegasaki
That's because I have a guest over right now.
Ooh, is it your boyfriend？
Hehe, bingo! He's my boyfriend. But it's our little secret, okay？
('Boyfriend'... I like the sound of that.)
Asari
Yo, Anegasaki.
Anegasaki
Satoko？ Did we have plans today？
Nope, just in the area. Wanna grab tea together if you're free？
Sorry. Today's a bit... well, you know.
Oh, gotcha... Say no more. Next time, then!
(A school friend, huh. I wonder if she knows about ● too.)
Neighbor Lady B
*huff, puff*!
Anegasaki
Are you okay with all those bags？
They had a sale, and I went and bought way too much.
Here, let me take that. I'll help you.
Thanks so much, Nene-chan~.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is really popular with the neighbors, too.)
Neighbor Lady B
Huh, are you alone, Nene-chan？ Where's that boy from before？
Anegasaki
Ah... did you see us？
Clear as day! He is totally head over heels for you.
I... hope so. Though if anything, I think I'm the one who's...
(...Now I'm really curious what they were talking about.)
Anegasaki
Sorry to keep you waiting! Were you okay on your own？
Yeah, totally fine.
Anegasaki
Ah, hey! Cut that out!
Whoa! Wh-What？
Geez. Do that again... and you're gonna get it.
Anegasaki
So, um... I'm having trouble deciding what to wear on our date...
I can help you pick.
You should decide for yourself.
Anegasaki
Geez. You're supposed to help your girlfriend out, you know.
(Thinking about what she'll wear is half the fun, though...)
Anegasaki
Hehe, thanks. Wait here, okay？ I'll be right back.
Anegasaki
Ta-da! How is it？ Does it suit me？
Looks amazing on you!
Maybe try another outfit？
Anegasaki
Really？ Thank you! Could you take a look at another one, too？
Anegasaki
Oh... Not feeling this one？ Okay, I'll go change into something else, alright？
Anegasaki
Then... how about something like this？
It's perfect!
I'd love to see something cute.
Something neat and classy, maybe.
Let's go with something casual.
How about something sexy？
Anegasaki
Whew, good! Mm-hmm, so this is the one.
Anegasaki
I see... Then what kind of style would you like to see？
A skirt would be nice.
I love dresses.
I think pants would suit you.
Something that shows skin, please!
Anegasaki
Got it. Wait here, I'll go change.
Anegasaki
...So you like that style. I'll see what I can find.
Anegasaki
Geez, you're always teasing. ...Though if it's just inside my room...
Anegasaki
Thanks for waiting! How about this？
Anegasaki
How about this one？
Anegasaki
Ta-daaa! How's this one？
The first one was the best.
My vote goes to the last one.
Yeah, this one's great!
Actually, I'll leave it to you.
Anegasaki
I knew it! You really like this kind, huh？
Anegasaki
Really？ ...Hmm, let me think about it for a bit.
Anegasaki
Geez, after all that... Now I'll be fretting over it until that day.
Anegasaki
Ah, look at the time already.
You're right. I should probably head home soon.
Anegasaki
Sorry for keeping you so late.
No, I hate to leave, but I really should get going.
Okay. I'll walk you downstairs.
Anegasaki
Am I the only one... who wants to stay together a little longer？
● was thinking the exact same thing.
Sorry, I should head home for today.
Anegasaki
Hehe. We're totally on the same wavelength.
Anegasaki
Haah, can't be helped if I get turned down. I'll walk you downstairs.
Anegasaki
Thanks for today. Head straight home, and get back safe, okay？
Come on in, make yourself at home.
Anegasaki
Thanks. Don't mind if I do, then.
Come on in. Not that it's much to brag about.
Anegasaki
Excuse me. Did you tidy up properly, I wonder？
Here we are. Come on in.
Anegasaki
Excuse me, ▼ Maybe I'll inspect my boyfriend's room？
Is this the first time you've come over to my place？
Anegasaki
Yeah. Coming over like this might be a first.
It's not that clean, but make yourself at home.
Anegasaki
Modest, modest.
Anegasaki
It makes me want to say, 'I'm home, ▼'
Then ● should say, 'Welcome home,' huh.
Anegasaki
I wonder why. It's not my room, but it feels so relaxing.
That's 'cause ● is right next to you.
Hey now, don't get cocky. ...Though you might actually be right.
Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ right beside ● always gives me energy.
Am I your daily vitamin？ One tablet a day, don't forget.
Haha, keep 'em coming every day, then.
Anegasaki
A guy's room really is different, isn't it？
Really？ In what way？
Yeah. Feels like there's lots of square things. Girls' rooms have more round things, you know？
I see... You might be right.
Right？ Maybe I should make this room a little rounder too.
If that's what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wants, I don't mind.
Keep that up and I'll gradually turn it into a room to my own tastes.
Anegasaki
Being like this makes me not want to go home, huh.
Is it time for you to go already？
Nope. I just meant it's sad knowing the time to leave is getting closer.
Then...
Hehe. As if you wouldn't panic if I really said I'm not leaving.
Anegasaki
Well now. Time to give your room a proper inspection, I think.
...Did what？
Ooh, that's a suspicious reaction. Got something here you don't want me seeing？
No way! Check as much as you like.
Just kidding. I just wanted to sound a little like a girlfriend.
（Even with nothing to hide, my heart's pounding...）
Anegasaki
Do you ever talk to yourself when you're in your room？
Talk to myself？ Hmm, once in a while, maybe.
I guess I do too, once in a while.
Well, you could always call me if you want.
Thanks. But if I called you for stuff like that, I don't think I'd ever be able to stop.
Anegasaki
Speaking of which, do you air out your futon？
Well... more or less？
No good! You have to air it out properly.
Airing it out is such a hassle. If I had time for that, I'd rather go on a date with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I mean... that's sweet, but still, no! You have to air it out properly.
All right~
Anegasaki
Today's horoscope for Aries was the absolute best!
Oh yeah？ So how is it actually going？
Huh？ You're no good as a boyfriend if you can't tell how your girlfriend is feeling.
Well, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is always smiling anyway.
I'm with you, so of course I'm not gonna be sulking. Right？
（She seems in a good mood, so maybe it was right.）
Anegasaki
Hey, are you the type who cooks for yourself？
A bit, here and there.
Apparently guys who can cook are pretty popular with girls.
Haha, I'm not that good.
I actually prefer a guy who isn't great at cooking or chores. That way, I can help out, right？
（That's so like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.）
Anegasaki
Hey, what's the most expensive thing in your room？
Hmm, what could it be... My computer, maybe？ Other than that... beats me.
Then what's the most precious thing？
...That would be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. My girlfriend, of course.
Aww, geez, that's unfair!
（All right, perfect answer.）
Anegasaki
You're awfully quiet today.
Not at all.
Then I guess you're just completely relaxed？
That could be it. With you next to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, even doing nothing feels nice.
There you go, sweet-talking me. Still... spending time like this isn't bad at all.
（Now if only I could rest my head in her lap...）
Anegasaki
Hey, what made you decide on this apartment？
Probably the rent and how close it is to school？
For me, I thought about whether I could picture myself actually living there.
Picturing myself living here, huh... I never could've imagined having a girlfriend like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ coming over, though.
Hey now, there you go saying cute things again♪
Huh？ Is that your pen on the desk, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
...Aw, you found it.
Eh？
Operation: Slowly leave more of my stuff here... officially a failure.
Come on, you didn't have to sneak around to do that.
Sneaking it in is the fun part for things like this.
(Guess next time I'll pretend I didn't notice？)
Anegasaki
Why do I feel so at home here？ Maybe I'm just weird.
Haha, not at all. Though you really do look right at home in the room, ●.
Can you relax next to me, too？
Yeah. I mean, I'm still a little nervous, though.
Right...？ Maybe I really am weird. I feel so at ease, I'm getting sleepy.
(Could she just be sleep-deprived...？)
Anegasaki
Your room is pretty spacious. I'm jealous.
You think so？ Well, it's plenty for living alone.
What about for two people？
Never miiind~.
(That surprised me...)
Do you read manga, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
I do. Shoujo manga, ladies' comics, that kind of thing.
Ladies' comics... What are those like？
What are they like... Hmm, kind of hard to explain to a boy.
Anegasaki
Huh？ There's dust gathering on the floor.
Oh, you're right. And here I thought I cleaned.
Picturing you cleaning all by yourself is kinda cute, though.
Cute？ Why？
I don't really know why. But clumsily vacuuming away... Hehe, see？ Totally cute.
(What is she imagining...？)
Anegasaki
Ah, again. Looks like there's a stray around here.
...A stray cat. Someone might be feeding it.
I can totally understand wanting to feed it.
Yeah, like wanting to feed animals at the zoo.
And a growing boyfriend, too.
(So to ●, I'm the same as a stray cat...？)
Anegasaki
I saw a bunch of instant ramen stocked in the kitchen earlier.
Oh, yeah, for late-night snacks and stuff.
You can't just live on instant food, okay？
All right~
And you had tons of canned food, too. Don't overdo it, okay？
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Anegasaki
Tickle-tickle-tickle~!
Whoa! Haha, what are you doing?!
I suddenly got nervous... Laughing is supposed to help you relax, right？
...I'm not sure that helped, though？
Then... how about some more？
Anegasaki
Do you think fewer homes have traditional closets these days？
Maybe？ Modern, stylish apartments probably don't have them.
You know, I actually really like closets like that. All dark and... quiet, maybe？
Spoken like a true horror fan.
That's got nothing to do with it! When I got shut in the closet as a kid, I wasn't even scared.
I kind of get it. Small, dark spaces just make you want to climb inside.
Right？ Want to try squeezing in together sometime？
(A closet date...？)
Hey, I bought a new game. Want to play together？
Hey, feel like playing a game？
Anegasaki
A game？ Sure, sounds fun. What kind is it？
Puzzle Dama
Yie Ar Kung-Fu +
TwinBee +
Anegasaki
A game？ Hmm, maybe some other time, okay？
Gotcha. Well, don't worry about it.
Anegasaki
I wonder if I can play this one too.
Anegasaki
That one, huh... Sure! I'm not gonna lose, though.
Anegasaki
Oh, that one! I'm actually pretty good at it, you know.
Anegasaki
Hmm, I'm not really in the mood for that right now.
Anegasaki
Knowing full well I'm bad at it？ You're such a meanie.
Oh yeah, I got a new DVD. Want to watch it together？
Want to watch a DVD together？
Anegasaki
Sure, sounds good! What do you want to watch？
Movie: Romance
Movie: Action
Movie: Comedy
Movie: Sci-Fi
Movie: Horror
Movie: Anime
Anegasaki
...I think I'll pass for now. Sorry.
Really...？
Anegasaki
Really？ I was actually hoping to watch that too.
Anegasaki
If that's what you want to watch, let's go with that.
Anegasaki
I see... Hmm, can we pick something else？
Anegasaki
Just as good as I hoped！ I got totally sucked in.
Anegasaki
Yeah... Something like this is nice once in a while.
Anegasaki
I guess that one just wasn't really for me...
I've got a new CD. Want to listen to it？
Some music would be nice. Want to put on a CD？
Anegasaki
Sure, what kind is it？
Anegasaki
What a great song... I think I might be a fan now.
Anegasaki
Hey, want to play a game？
That looks good！
Puzzle Dama
Yie Ar Kung-Fu +
TwinBee +
Anegasaki
You know, I'd really love to watch a movie.
Sounds good
●'m not really feeling it...
Anegasaki
Turned down, huh...？ No, it's fine. Don't worry.
Anegasaki
Time always flies with you. It's funny, isn't it？
● feel the same. But I really should head home.
Anegasaki
I guess I should get going...
I see...
Anegasaki
Hmm, it's about that time... What should we do？
A little longer should be fine？
Better not make it too late
Anegasaki
Trying to keep me here？ Geez, you're so cute, ▼.
Anegasaki
Thank you... but I think I'll head home for today.
Anegasaki
You're right. Well, thanks for today.
Anegasaki
I know, but... I still want to be with you a bit longer. Can I be a little selfish？
Of course！
Then I'll walk you home.
Anegasaki
Hey, how's your stomach？ Aren't you hungry？
Actually, I'm starving.
Anegasaki
Really？ I've added some new dishes to my repertoire.
Awesome！
Want to eat out instead？
Anegasaki
How about I cook something, then？
I'd love that！
Let's just eat out
Anegasaki
I see. Want to go grab something to eat, then？
I'd love it if you cooked...
Let's do that
Anegasaki
You're that happy about it？ Alright, I'll go all out, ▼！
I can't wait！
Anegasaki
Good boy. I'll make you something delicious, okay？
I have high hopes!
I'll help out with groceries or whatever you need.
Anegasaki
Can't help it, then... Wait just a bit, okay？
Anegasaki
Even if you say that, I haven't got anything ready, you know...
I see... Too bad, guess we'll just give up and go eat out.
Anegasaki
Jeez... You really don't get it.
Anegasaki
So, where do you wanna eat？
How about this place？
Anegasaki
Yeah. Sounds good.
Anegasaki
There we go. Alright, I'll put my heart into making this!
Anegasaki
I wanted a change of pace... Maybe I'll just cook dressed like this.
Anegasaki
Have you decided on your order？ If you have a request, go right ahead.
What should I get...？
I'm in the mood for Japanese.
Western food, definitely.
I feel like Chinese food.
Not sure what kind, but...
...Sweets!
Genre 6 ※ Unused
I'd like ▲料理ジャンル▲.
Anegasaki
You have great taste, sir! That happens to be our top recommendation♪
Anegasaki
Understood, sir!
Anegasaki
That one... might take a little time.
Anegasaki
Huh!? That... Well, I'll do my best, but I'm a bit nervous.
Anegasaki
Cooking is all about rhythm, and... there!
